description: Frozen labelled (claim, evidence, label) triples for citation faithfulness: does the cited evidence entail the claim? Measures verification only; answer generation is held out of scope.

labelling_protocol.construction: Six triples per corpus file: faithful-a and faithful-b take a corpus sentence verbatim with its own file as evidence; paraphrase rewords fact A preserving every entity and number; contradicted flips exactly one fact slot in fact A against the correct evidence; invented pairs a fabricated in-style claim with its own real file (security finding F4 shape: valid-looking citation, no support); swapped keeps the verbatim fact-A claim and replaces the evidence with the next file's text (source-20 pairs with source-01).
labelling_protocol.evidence_definition: Verbatim full text of one corpus file (the unit a retrieval chunk would return), trailing whitespace stripped.
labelling_protocol.label_semantics: supported = the evidence entails the claim; unsupported = the evidence contradicts the claim or fails to state part of it.
